configSchema.name: jobNimbusRecord
configSchema.description: JobNimbus record type to create/update: 'job' or 'contact' (defaults to 'job')

configSchema.name: workflowType
configSchema.description: JobNimbus record_type_name to assign, e.g. Customer (defaults to 'Customer')

configSchema.name: defaultCompanyName
configSchema.description: Fallback company name used for JobNimbus contacts when the account has no business name

configSchema.name: defaultStatus
configSchema.description: Fallback JobNimbus status_name used when no statusFields/statusValues mapping matches

configSchema.name: statusFields
configSchema.description: Terros account field(s) (CF.* or a dotted path) whose value determines the JobNimbus status; checked in order until one resolves via statusValues

configSchema.name: statusValues
configSchema.description: Map a raw value read via statusFields to the JobNimbus status_name to send

configSchema.name: workflowId
configSchema.description: Terros workflow id (WF.*) to apply to accounts created/updated from JobNimbus job webhooks

configSchema.name: accountSource
configSchema.description: Terros accountSource to record on the account (defaults to 'JobNimbus')

configSchema.name: requestType
configSchema.description: Terros account/upsert request type: 'create', 'update', or 'upsert' (defaults to 'upsert')
